thread:
Maya Singh: Quick check for MapleBridge private onboarding  blockers before we schedule the cutover window: (1) audit-log shape & delivery, (2) CMK ownership + rotation cadence. Can we close these today?

Arman Rao: They said JSONL single-line events. Can they paste an example? Also need to know if logging uses mTLS or IP allowlist.

Maya Singh: Paste from their security team below (single-line JSON per event): {"tenant":"maplebridge","ts":"2026-03-24T15:09:01Z","event":"inference","model":"rwd-13b","req_tokens":32,"resp_tokens":96,"redacted":true}

Leah Kim: KMS question: do they insist on CMK in their account? If yes we need a key policy that grants us crypto ops only and denies admin actions. Also confirm rotation cadence.

Maya Singh: They require customer-owned CMK in their AWS account. Rotation: 90 days preferred, but they said they will manage rotation. They want aliasing so configs point to an alias instead of ARN. They explicitly stated Redwood must not be a key administrator.

audit-bot: Security checklist: - Audit events must include tenant + ts + request_id. - Strip PII before export (masking on ingest). - KMS policy must grant our service principal kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey and deny kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion and kms:DisableKey. - If using log forwarder, prefer mTLS; else customer must provide three egress IPs.

Arman Rao: Networking: MapleBridge prefers customer NAT with Elastic IPs (preferred). If they need us to present egress IPs for a test, we can provide 3 IPs but require a short window. I'll add both options to the runbook and ask them to confirm which approach.

Leah Kim: I'll draft a concise KMS key-policy snippet for them to paste (replace ARNs/account IDs) and post it after our 20-min sync. Also adding the audit JSONL sample to the runbook.

infra-bot: runbook updated by Arman Rao  added steps: "audit-jsonl-sample", "customer-cmk-90d", "egress-elastic-ips-or-fallback". Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/MapleBridge/runbook (internal)

Maya Singh: Scheduling a 20-min sync at 16:00 PT to confirm KMS policy and the three Elastic IPs / collector FQDN. Invite sent to MapleBridge security and network.

Arman Rao: After the call I'll post the runbook diff and the exact policy snippet to their security alias.

Maya Singh: Perfect, thanks. Once they publish the CMK ARN and confirm the egress option we'll mark readiness for cutover.
